The '''Secundus Ando system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
